The translation gives separate bounds for multiplication and addition. Together, they recover the requested bound: the combined error is at most \(u+(1+u)\gamma(d,u)\leq\gamma(d+1,u)\). Both bounds apply to the same constructed trees, so they also recover the required link to exact products.
